summary: Klamath County, OR ground lookout (Hambleton Butte): cabin moved from Chase Mountain in 1951, abandoned 1966, listed gone; 1967 survey note; site today undescribed.

facts.design: 8x8 ground cabin with separate living quarters (1951, moved from Chase Mountain); firelookout.com gives a 10x10 cab in 1949
facts.status_note: Firelookout.com and the Forest Fire Lookout Association list it as gone; the Forest Lookouts page and the Klamath blog say removed, with no date; a 1967 survey note still describes a 15-ft wooden building; no source describes the site today

staffing.status: no longer manned regularly; a guard from Kings Cabin Guard Station assigned during intense storms

facts.agency: Long-Bell Timber Company / Long Bell Lumber Company with the Klamath Forest Protective Association

events.note: Forest Lookouts page 1922 entry: connection to a Long Bell forest guard and lookout network; the same entry names the Calimus Butte Lookout (a separate site on the Oregon list) and says a lookout was on the Hambleton summit; date unconfirmed for this site
10x10 cab per firelookout.com; conflicts with the 1951 date
Lookout house moved here from Chase Mountain by the Klamath FPA; 8x8 ground cabin
Survey description first lists the site as the Kings Cabin lookout house
Lightning-set snag fire at Deep Creek, south of Yamsay Mountain; detected from the station about 6:15 p.m., suppressed before 9 p.m.
Coast and Geodetic Survey recovery note describes a 15-ft wooden building painted brown
No longer manned regularly; other lookouts cover the area; a Kings Cabin guard assigned during intense storms (Herald and News item)

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Klamath blog gives unidentified 1920s structures; the Forest Lookouts page has a 1922 entry that names the Calimus Butte Lookout (a separate site on the Oregon list) while saying a lookout was on the Hambleton summit, so the 1922 date is unconfirmed for this site; firelookout.com gives a 1932 camp. The story reports these without choosing one.
Firelookout.com gives a 1949 10x10 cab; the Forest Lookouts page and the Klamath blog give a 1951 8x8 cabin moved from Chase Mountain. The story uses 1951 and mentions the 1949 record.

notes_for_editor: Name: firelookout.com and the index say Hamelton; the Forest Lookouts page and the blog say Hambleton; a 1963 newspaper quote on the Forest Lookouts page says Hamilton. Township: the brief and the Forest Lookouts page say 32S-11E-24, but the Klamath blog says Sec 24 T32S R12E. Not resolved here; check the land survey before changing the brief. Elevation 6,421 ft is from firelookout.com and is not in facts. Not used: the blog's 1928 letters about a planned lookout on Yamsay Mountain, which are not about this summit. The 15-ft height is the 1967 survey description, not a verified original height. Checked 2026-10-10: the story no longer presents the 1922 entry as a Hambleton event without the Calimus Butte caveat, and drops an unsourced 1960s 'from the summit' guard claim.
